Evaluation in QA-SRL involves, for each verb, aligning its predicted argument spans to a reference set of arguments, and evaluating question equivalence, i.e., whether predicted and gold questions for aligned spans correspond to the same semantic role.
Through manual evaluation of 50 sampled predicates...
Through manual evaluation of 50 sampled predicates, we detect correctly predicted arguments and questions that were rejected by the IOU and STRICT-MATCH criteria.

We first release a preliminary crowd-wide annotation round, and then contact workers who exhibit reasonable performance. They are asked to review our short guidelines, which highlight a few subtle aspects, and then annotate two qualification rounds, of 15 predicates each.
